| `acs_vcs_overflow_space` | 152 | — | 448 | `bytes[56]` | not recorded | `ro` | SupplementDefined · tags: VCS, SupplementDefined, ControlSet | `dynamic` (implied by `is_dynamic: true`) | not recorded | section: OIF-CMIS-VCS-01.1 § 4.4 · pdf_page: 18 · table: Table 4-1 | Active Control Set VCS overflow space, page 19h bytes 152-207. Read-only VCS Parameters are populated in the Active Control Set memory space only, after all read-write VCS Parameters have been allocated (§ 4.4): they are advertised by the read-only VCS Descriptor CDB command (§ 6.5) in order, and the ones that do not fit in the page 11h Active Control Set register space (bytes 214-234) appear here. The layout inside this space is module-advertised: offsets are computed from the accumulated MemoryLength attributes of the advertised VCS Descriptors, and a VCS Parameter must be fully contained within a page (§ 4.4), so individual parameter offsets and lengths inside this space are not recorded. Where read-write VCS Parameters themselves overflow the Active Control Set in-page space is not recorded: § 4.4 states read-write register offsets are the same for all Control Sets, but the staged overflow is page 18h bytes 144-255 while page 19h bytes 144-151 carry the CMIS base NAD block indices, and the specification does not state the Active placement. Register formats per parameter are recorded in the CmisVcsParameterId enum. |
